examples.text: saṅg'ātigo yassa na santi saṅgā, yo mānasattesu amānasatto, dukkhaṃ pariññāya sakhettavatthuṃ, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.

75276.meaning1: wearing away of grasping; ending of clinging; extinction of attachment
75276.commentary: (SNPa) upādānakhaye vimutto'ti nibbāne nibbān'ārammaṇato vimutto, nibbān'ārammaṇa-vimuttilābhī'ti attho.

examples.text: paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, santo upādānakhaye vimutto, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.

75277.commentary: (SNPa) upadhivivekaninnena cittena taṇhakkhaye nibbāne visesena muttattā taṇhakkhaye vimuttaṃ, adhimuttan'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (SNPa) upādānakhaye vimutto'ti nibbāne nibbān'ārammaṇato vimutto, nibbān'ārammaṇa-vimuttilābhī'ti attho.

examples.text: paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, santo upādānakhaye vimutto, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.

75278.synonym: ahāsi, panudi, byapānudi, vinodayi, vinodi, vinodesi

examples.text: saṃyojanaṃ jātikhay'antadassī, yo-apānudi rāgapathaṃ asesaṃ, suddho nidoso vimalo akāco, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.
yo-apānudī maccurājassa senaṃ, naḷasetuṃ'va sudubbalaṃ mah'ogho, vijitāvī apetabheravo hi, danto so parinibbuto ṭhit'atto'ti.

75279.grammar: adj, from dosa, irreg form of niddosa, neg
75279.commentary: (SNPa) yehi rāgadosā ayaṃ pajā, dosadosā, mohadosā'ti vuccati. tesaṃ abhāvā nidoso.

examples.text: saṃyojanaṃ jātikhay'antadassī, yo'pānudi rāgapathaṃ asesaṃ, suddho nidoso vimalo akāco, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.

75280.grammar: pr, from na anupassati, neg, trans (+acc)
75280.meaning1: does not see; does not consider; does not take (as)
75280.construction:
na + anu + passa + ti
na + anupassati
75280.commentary: (SNPa) attano attānaṃ n'ānupassatī'ti ñāṇasampayuttena cittena vipassanto attano khandhesu aññaṃ attānaṃ nāma na passati, khandhamattam'eva passati. yā c'āyaṃ attanā'va attānaṃ sañjānāmī'ti tassa saccato thetato diṭṭhi uppajjati, tassā abhāvā attano attānaṃ n'ānupassati, añña'd'atthu paññāya khandhe passati.

examples.text: yo attano attānaṃ n'ānupassati, samāhito ujjugato ṭhit'atto, sa ve anejo akhilo akaṅkho, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.
moh'antarā yassa na santi keci, sabbesu dhammesu ca ñāṇadassī, sarīrañ'ca antimaṃ dhāreti, patto ca sambodhimanuttaraṃ sivaṃ, ettāvatā yakkhassa suddhi, tathāgato arahati pūraḷāsaṃ.
sārambhā yassa vigatā, cittaṃ yassa anāvilaṃ, vippamutto ca kāmehi, thinaṃ yassa panūditaṃ.

75283.commentary: (SNPa) sīm'antānaṃ vinetāran'ti sīmā'ti mariyādā sādhujanavutti, tassā antā pariyosānā aparabhāgā'ti katvā sīm'antā vuccanti kilesā, tesaṃ vinetāran'ti attho. sīm'antā'ti buddhaveneyyā sekkhā ca puthujjanā ca, tesaṃ vinetāran'ti'pi eke.

examples.text: sīm'antānaṃ vinetāraṃ, jātimaraṇakovidaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, tādisaṃ yaññam'āgataṃ.

75284.commentary: (DNa) netā'ti taṃ taṃ atthaṃ dassento paññāya netā. vividhāni kāraṇāni dassento netī'ti vinetā. punappunaṃ netī'ti anunetā.

examples.text: saṅgāhako mittakaro, vadaññū vītamaccharo, netā vinetā anunetā, tādiso labhate yasaṃ.

75285.meaning1: expert in birth and death; skilled in being born and dying
75285.commentary: (SNPa) jātimaraṇakovidan'ti evaṃ jāti evaṃ maraṇan'ti ettha kusalaṃ.

examples.text: sīm'antānaṃ vinetāraṃ, jātimaraṇakovidaṃ, muniṃ moneyyasampannaṃ, tādisaṃ yaññam'āgataṃ.

75286.commentary: (SNPa) bhakuṭiṃ vinayitvānā'ti yaṃ ekacce dubbuddhino yācakaṃ disvā bhakuṭiṃ karonti, taṃ vinayitvā, pasannamukhā hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhakuṭiṃ vinayitvāna, pañjalikā namassatha, pūjetha annapānena, evaṃ ijjhanti dakkhiṇā.
buddho bhavaṃ arahati pūraḷāsaṃ, puññakhettam'anuttaraṃ, āyāgo sabbalokassa, bhoto dinnaṃ mahapphalan'ti.

75288.commentary: (SNPa) sabb'upadhīnaṃ parikkhayā'ti sabbesaṃ khandha-kāmaguṇa-kiles'ābhisaṅkhāra-bhedānaṃ upadhīnaṃ parikkhīṇattā katthaci asajjamāno

examples.text: aññāya padaṃ samecca dhammaṃ, vivaṭaṃ disvāna pahānam'āsavānaṃ, sabb'upadhīnaṃ parikkhayāno, sammā so loke paribbajeyya.

75289.synonym: anussāveti, ācikkhati, āmantayati, ārocayati, āroceti, pāvadati, pilapati

examples.text: suṇātha me bhikkhavo sāvayāmi vo, dhammaṃ dhutaṃ tañ'ca carātha sabbe, iriyāpathaṃ pabbajit'ānulomikaṃ, sevetha naṃ atthadaso mutīmā.
ahañ'hi, bho gotama, dāyako dānapati vadaññū yācayogo, dhammena bhoge pariyesāmi, dhammena bhoge pariyesitvā dhammaladdhehi bhogehi dhamm'ādhigatehi ekassa'pi dadāmi

75291.meaning1: who has cut all the chains and ropes; who has severed all bonds and ties

examples.text: ye sabbasaṃyojanabandhanacchidā, dantā vimuttā anīghā nirāsā, kālena tesu habyaṃ pavecche, yo brāhmaṇo puññapekkho yajetha.

75292.meaning1: freed from all the fetters; released from all bondage

examples.text: ye sabbasaṃyojanavippamuttā, dantā vimuttā anīghā nirāsā, kālena tesu habyaṃ pavecche, yo brāhmaṇo puññapekkho yajetha.

75293.meaning1: who has attained awakening; who has reached understanding

examples.text: yo vedagū jhānarato satīmā, sambodhipatto saraṇaṃ bahūnaṃ, kālena tamhi habyaṃ pavecche, yo brāhmaṇo puññapekkho yajetha.
buddho'ti ghosaṃ yada parato suṇāsi, sambodhipatto vivarati dhammam'aggaṃ, gantvāna tattha samayaṃ paripucchamāno, carassu tasmiṃ bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ.
yajassu yajamāno māghā'ti bhagavā, sabbattha ca vippasādehi cittaṃ, ārammaṇaṃ yajamānassa yañño, etthappatiṭṭhāya jahāti dosaṃ.

75295.commentary: (SNPa) sattesu ca pavineyya dosaṃ tappahānen'eva pahīnapañcanīvaraṇo anukkamena upacār'appanābhedaṃ aparimāṇasattapharaṇena ekasatte vā anavasesapharaṇena appamāṇaṃ mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvento puna bhāvanāvepullatthaṃ

examples.text: so vītarāgo pavineyya dosaṃ, mettaṃ cittaṃ bhāvayam'appamāṇaṃ, rattin'divaṃ satatam'appamatto, sabbā disā pharati appamaññaṃ.

75296.meaning1: name of an ascetic teacher; Makkhali Gosāla

examples.text: ye te samaṇabrāhmaṇā saṅghino gaṇino gaṇ'ācariyā ñātā yasassino titthakarā sādhusammatā bahujanassa, seyyath'idaṃ, pūraṇo kassapo makkhaligosālo ajito kesakambalo pakudho kaccāno sañcayo belaṭṭhaputto nigaṇṭho nāṭaputto

75297.meaning1: ends; puts an end to; finishes; completes

examples.text: dūrato āgato'si sabhiya, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tesam'antakaromi te pañhe te puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākaromi te.
acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! yaṃ vat'āhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattam'pi n'ālatthaṃ taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katan'ti.
